{{Quote|He ''[Stalnus]'' frequents planets in the Tendo system, where he is known to have a network of contacts who tip him about the arrival of law enforcement or bounty hunters.|Airen Cracken, ''Wanted by Cracken''|<ref name="Wanted" />}}
The '''Tendo system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="Wanted" /> located within the [[Quess sector/Legends|Quess sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]].<ref name="TEA" /> It contained several [[Planet/Legends|planets]] that were frequented by the [[Riorian/Legends|Riorian]] [[Death/Legends|murderer]] [[Stalnus]]. The criminal was known to have a network of contacts in the system who informed the Riorian whenever [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agents]] or [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] arrived to try and arrest him.<ref name="Wanted" /> In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="Date">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']] is dated to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates that conflict to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the placement of the sourcebook therefore translates to [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].</ref> the Tendo system was mentioned by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] within the [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] ''[[Wanted by Cracken]]'' in an entry dedicated to Stalnus.<ref name="Wanted" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tendo system was first mentioned in the [[1993]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']], which was written by [[Louis J. Prosperi]] for [[West End Games]].<ref name="Wanted" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the system in grid square N-17.<ref name="TEA" />
